title: MPA Pharma GmbH
description:
MPA Pharma GmbH is an internationally active, rapidly growing company specializing in the import and trade of high-quality pharmaceuticals, including both patented and generic products. With over 35 years of expertise in the pharmaceutical market, they also provide contract manufacturing services for third parties. Their primary clients include pharmacies and businesses in need of reliable pharmaceutical and medical products. 
Revenue $614 Million
